description: This file is a PHP source file for the vtiger CRM system, specifically handling report grouping logic. It includes functions to generate HTML for primary and secondary column grouping options, handles report record retrieval, and prepares data for rendering a report grouping UI template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the report grouping page.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: Represents a report object with methods and properties related to report configurations, including related modules and columns.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumns_GroupingHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML <option> and <optgroup> elements for primary module columns, allowing users to select primary grouping columns for reports.

methods.name: getSecondaryColumns_GroupingHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML options for secondary module columns, enabling secondary grouping selections in report configurations.

methods.name: getGroupByTimeDiv
methods.description: Returns HTML for a dropdown to select time-based grouping criteria (None, Year, Month, Quarter) for report grouping.
